+# Canonical cyclic factors of the p-adic odometer
+
+## Abstract
+
+Continuous symbolic observations of a p-adic adding machine have one finite cyclic resolution for every starting point and all integer times.
+
+**Theorem 1.1 (One residue depth reconstructs every symbolic coordinate).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S1/Dynamics/OdometerCyclicFactor.exists_cyclic_factor_of_shift_equivariant`
+
+*Proof.* Machine-checked in Lean as `D5/S1/Dynamics/OdometerCyclicFactor.exists_cyclic_factor_of_shift_equivariant` (`✓ std3`). ∎
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+Let p be prime, A any discrete topological space, and Φ:Z_p→A^Z continuous. Assume Φ(x+1)(n)=Φ(x)(n+1) for every p-adic integer x and every integer n. Then there exist N≥0 and w:Z/(p^N)Z→A such that, simultaneously for every x and n, Φ(x)(n)=w(π_N(x)+n), where π_N is the actual Mathlib ring homomorphism PadicInt.toZModPow N. The alphabet A need not be finite.
+
+The zero-coordinate observation c(x)=Φ(x)(0) is continuous and locally constant. Its fibers cover compact Z_p. A Lebesgue number gives one radius δ>0 on which c is constant, independently of x. Choose N with p^(-N)<δ. Equal π_N residues put x-y in the ideal generated by p^N; Mathlib's kernel and norm theorems give distance at most p^(-N), so c agrees on every canonical residue fiber. Set w(a)=c(a.val), using the natural representative of the finite residue.
+
+Integer induction on equivariance, with a separate backward step using x-1, shows Φ(x)(n)=c(x+n) for both positive and negative n. Applying the one quotient factorization and the ring-homomorphism addition law gives the displayed formula. The same N controls all initial points and all times; it is not chosen separately for each orbit. The case N=0 is retained and gives a constant symbolic factor.
+
+This is a classical compactness and equicontinuity consequence. The existing EquicontinuousObservationPeriod theorem supplies a general positive observation period; this result additionally identifies the canonical p-power residue quotient and reconstructs the complete two-sided name through it. It supplies no effective algorithm for finding N from an arbitrary continuity proof and no uniform bound on N independent of the observer.
+
+## References
+
+- Truth anchor: `D5/S1/Dynamics/OdometerCyclicFactor.exists_cyclic_factor_of_shift_equivariant`

+# Exact Root Arithmetic in the Dyadic Solenoid
+
+## Abstract
+
+The odd part q of a positive degree determines its cyclic multiplication kernel and the exact cardinality q of every root fiber in the dyadic solenoid.
+
+Use the existing DyadicSolenoid from DyadicTimeSeparation: sequences in AddCircle(1) satisfying 2 x(n+1)=x(n), with the topology inherited from the product of circles. Circle period one is fixed throughout. No new carrier or replacement topology is introduced.
+
+**Theorem 1.1 (Cyclic kernels and exact root fibers).**
+
+$$\forall k \in N,\; \forall q \in N,\; \operatorname{Odd}\left(q\right) \Rightarrow \left(\operatorname{Nonempty}\left(\operatorname{AddEquiv}\left(\operatorname{Kernel}\left(\operatorname{nsmul}\left(2^{k} \cdot q, S2\right)\right), \operatorname{ZMod}\left(q\right)\right)\right) \land \left(\forall a \in S2,\; \operatorname{Finite}\left(\operatorname{RootFiber}\left(2^{k} \cdot q, a\right)\right) \land \operatorname{card}\left(\operatorname{RootFiber}\left(2^{k} \cdot q, a\right)\right) = q\right)\right)$$
+
+*Proof.* Machine-checked in Lean as `D5/S1/Solenoid/DyadicRootFiberArithmetic.dyadic_root_fiber_arithmetic` (`✓ std3`). ∎
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+For every natural k and odd natural q, put m=2^k q. The kernel of the additive multiplication homomorphism by m is additively equivalent to ZMod q. For every a in S2 the subtype of x satisfying m x=a is finite and its Nat.card is q. Oddness implies q is positive; q=1, k=0 and m=1 are included. Every positive natural degree has this factorization by Nat.exists_eq_two_pow_mul_odd. Thus multiplication by powers of two is bijective, and all other positive degrees have exactly their odd part many roots at each target.
+
+Write q=2d+1 and s=d+1. On q-torsion in the circle, 2s acts as q+1, hence as the identity. Compatibility therefore forces x(n+1)=s x(n), so x(n)=s^n x(0). Conversely each ZMod q element z gives the compatible sequence s^n ZMod.toAddCircle(z). Coordinate zero proves injectivity using ZMod.toAddCircle_injective. AddCircle.nsmul_eq_zero_iff supplies every possible initial coordinate as r/q modulo one, proving surjectivity. The zero kernel of doubling in dyadic_time_separation removes the factor 2^k. Its positive-degree surjectivity, together with AddMonoidHom.fiberEquivKerOfSurjective, identifies each root fiber with that cyclic kernel.
+

+# Recursive joint residuals and adaptive transcripts
+
+## Abstract
+
+Recursive refinement of complete typed source rows preserves every finite acquired adaptive transcript law.
+
+An interface specifies source states and observations at each type, parameterized actions between types, and action-specific events, records and terminals. A source supplies its actual observation, legal domain, normalized legal rows and a declared refusal event, terminal and record for every illegal attempt. The total row uses the legal row on its legal domain and a point mass on that refusal triple elsewhere.
+
+The zero residual is equality of actual current observations. Each next residual retains the preceding relation and compares legality and the entire joint row for every same-type action. Only successful successors are replaced by their preceding residual classes. Events, records and individual typed terminal identities are preserved. Taking the realized image of this output projection changes no equality of joint rows: projection back to the output carrier recovers the usual quotient pushforward.
+
+A policy receives the remaining horizon, current interface observation, acquired archive and full ordered history. Its selector returns a probability distribution on stopping or parameterized typed actions. Selected actions satisfy its declared permission predicate. Archive updates may use the entire acquired prefix and each new complete block of acquired tokens; the selector has no source-state, quotient-class or probability-table argument. Source legality remains part of the total row, so a permitted attempt can still produce an explicit source refusal.
+
+Execution appends the actual observation before selection. A selected action is recorded, then its complete source row is sampled. The event and record are appended and written into the archive before a successful successor continues. A fixed terminal ends execution and is recorded distinctly. Stopping and exhaustion have separate tags. Thus run is an independently constructed probability mass function on full ordered histories jointly with chronological archive snapshots, including the initial archive and every update after observations, chosen actions, event-record blocks and terminal, stop or horizon tags. The archive writer may leave any such block unchanged. This is constructed execution, rather than a supplied transcript-law table.
+
+**Theorem 1.1 (Recursive residuals preserve finite adaptive laws).**
+
+$$\forall T: Interface, S: \operatorname{Source}\left(T\right), C: \operatorname{Type}, n: \mathbb{N}, i: \operatorname{Ty}\left(T\right), z, w: \operatorname{State}\left(T, i\right), \operatorname{residual}\left(S, n, i, z, w\right) \Rightarrow \forall d: \mathbb{N}, d \leq n \Rightarrow \forall P: \operatorname{Policy}\left(T, C\right), c: C, h: \operatorname{List}\left(\operatorname{Token}\left(T\right)\right), \operatorname{run}\left(S, P, d, i, z, c, h\right) = \operatorname{run}\left(S, P, d, i, w, c, h\right)$$
+
+*Proof.* Machine-checked in Lean as `D5/S3/Observer/ProbabilisticClosure/RecursiveJointTranscript.recursive_residual_preserves_adaptive_law` (`✓ std3`). ∎
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+The interfaces, source, archive type, residual depth and smaller execution depth are arbitrary. The two initial states have the same interface type and recursive residual class. Initial archives and acquired prefixes match. The conclusion compares full probability mass functions, including every ordered correlation, for every policy with the declared acquired inputs.
+
+Induction anchors observations at depth zero. At the next depth the selectors receive equal observations and identical acquired inputs. For each selected action the induction hypothesis makes its full continuation law constant on the preceding successor classes, uniformly in the newly written archive. The realized-image factorization criterion factors this continuation through the joint output projection. Binding it against equal projected source rows proves the step, retaining event-record-successor correlations and each fixed terminal.
+
+`D5/S3/ConceptDynamics/RefinementFactorization/RealizedImageKernelFactorization.realized_image_unique_factorization_iff_reverse_kernel` supplies the realized-image factor directly. The finite adaptive induction supplies the continuation invariance.
+
+All finite policies use the same typed action menu and interpreter. Finite prefixes are obtained by truncating execution; an acquired-history continuation uses that same interpreter after the prefix. The result therefore applies to every experiment in any declared family closed under these legal operations. No same-level lumpability is required. The discrete PMF argument also covers arbitrary finite or countable actual common sources, stochastic rows with zeros, multiple interfaces and actions, and unbounded acquired archive carriers.
+
+This is the positive implication from recursive joint residuals to finite transcript-law equivalence. It does not prove its converse, identify hidden states from equal observations, give an observer a full law table, establish one-run certification, or assert realization of every completion thread. Conditional identifiability, acquisition and physical claims require their separate contracts.
+

+    ∀ a : DyadicSolenoid,
+      Finite {x : DyadicSolenoid // (2 ^ k * q) • x = a} ∧
+      Nat.card {x : DyadicSolenoid // (2 ^ k * q) • x = a} = q := by
+  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := hq
+  have hpos : 0 < q := by omega
+  let : NeZero q := ⟨by omega⟩
+  let s := d + 1
+  have hs : 2 * s = q + 1 := by dsimp [s]; omega
+  have ht (z : ZMod q) : q • ZMod.toAddCircle z = 0 := by
+    rw [← map_nsmul, nsmul_eq_mul, ZMod.natCast_self, zero_mul, map_zero]
+  let lift : ZMod q →+ DyadicSolenoid :=
+    { toFun := fun z => ⟨fun n => (s ^ n : ℕ) • ZMod.toAddCircle z, by
+        intro n
+        change 2 • ((s ^ (n + 1) : ℕ) • ZMod.toAddCircle z) = _
+        calc
+          _ = (s ^ n : ℕ) • ((2 * s) • ZMod.toAddCircle z) := by
+            simp only [pow_succ, ← mul_smul]
+            congr 1
+            ring
+          _ = _ := by rw [hs, add_nsmul, ht]; simp⟩
+      map_zero' := by ext n; simp
+      map_add' := by intro z w; ext n; simp }
+  let f : ZMod q →+ (nsmulAddMonoidHom (α := DyadicSolenoid) (2 ^ k * q)).ker :=
+    { toFun := fun z => ⟨lift z, by
+        change (2 ^ k * q) • lift z = 0
+        rw [mul_smul]
+        have hz : q • lift z = 0 := by
+          ext n
+          change q • ((s ^ n : ℕ) • ZMod.toAddCircle z) = 0
+          rw [smul_comm, ht, smul_zero]
+        rw [hz, smul_zero]⟩
+      map_zero' := by apply Subtype.ext; exact lift.map_zero
+      map_add' := by intro z w; apply Subtype.ext; exact lift.map_add z w }
+  have hinj : Function.Injective f := by
+    intro z w he
+    apply ZMod.toAddCircle_injective q
+    have he0 := congrArg (fun y : (nsmulAddMonoidHom (α := DyadicSolenoid) (2 ^ k * q)).ker =>
+      y.1.1 0) he
+    simpa [f, lift] using he0
+  have hsurj : Function.Surjective f := by
+    intro x
+    have hx : q • x.1 = 0 := by
+      apply strip_twos k
+      rw [← mul_smul]
+      exact AddMonoidHom.mem_ker.mp x.2
+    have hx0 : q • x.1.1 0 = 0 := congrArg (fun y : DyadicSolenoid => y.1 0) hx
+    obtain ⟨r, _, hr⟩ := (AddCircle.nsmul_eq_zero_iff hpos).mp hx0
+    refine ⟨(r : ZMod q), ?_⟩
+    apply Subtype.ext
+    apply Subtype.ext
+    funext n
+    change (s ^ n : ℕ) • ZMod.toAddCircle (r : ZMod q) = x.1.1 n
+    rw [torsion_coordinates q s hs x.1 hx n]
+    congr 1
+    simpa using (ZMod.toAddCircle_natCast (N := q) r).trans (by simpa using hr)
+  let e := (AddEquiv.ofBijective f ⟨hinj, hsurj⟩).symm
+  refine ⟨⟨e⟩, ?_⟩
+  intro a
+  have hm : 0 < 2 ^ k * q := Nat.mul_pos (by positivity) hpos
+  let t := (nsmulAddMonoidHom (α := DyadicSolenoid) (2 ^ k * q)).fiberEquivKerOfSurjective
+    (dyadic_time_separation.2.2.2.2.1 _ hm) a
+  let eqv := t.trans e.toEquiv
+  have : Finite {x : DyadicSolenoid // (2 ^ k * q) • x = a} :=
+    Finite.of_equiv (ZMod q) eqv.symm
+  exact ⟨inferInstance, (Nat.card_congr eqv).trans (by simp [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card])⟩
+
+end D5.S1.Solenoid.DyadicSolenoid

+/- GID: D5/S3/Observer/ProbabilisticClosure/RecursiveJointTranscript
+   generality: G
+   mirror-B: D5/B/S3/Observer/ProbabilisticClosure/RecursiveJointTranscript
+   mirror-E: none(waiver:evidence-not-specified-by-formal-manifest)
+   anchors: []
+   utility: none
+   digest: Recursive typed joint residuals preserve complete ordered adaptive transcript laws. -/
+
+import D5.S3.ConceptDynamics.RefinementFactorization.RealizedImageKernelFactorization
+import Mathlib.Probability.ProbabilityMassFunction.Constructions
+
+/-! Typed source rows and their finite adaptive acquired-history laws. -/
+
+set_option autoImplicit false
+set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
+
+noncomputable section
+
+namespace D5.S3.Observer.ProbabilisticClosure.RecursiveJointTranscript
+
+open D5.S3.ConceptDynamics.RefinementFactorization.RealizedImageKernelFactorization
+
+universe u
+
+/-- Action values include their parameters and permission requirements. Each
+terminal belongs to its action's typed interface, disjoint from successful states. -/
+structure Interface where
+  Ty : Type u
+  State : Ty → Type u
+  Observation : Ty → Type u
+  Action : Ty → Ty → Type u
+  Event : {i j : Ty} → Action i j → Type u
+  Record : {i j : Ty} → Action i j → Type u
+  Terminal : {i j : Ty} → Action i j → Type u
+
+abbrev Output (T : Interface.{u}) {i j : T.Ty} (a : T.Action i j) :=
+  T.Event a × (T.State j ⊕ T.Terminal a) × T.Record a
+
+/-- The source supplies legal rows and the complete normalized refusal triple.
+Fields affecting future legality or responses belong to the source or records. -/
+structure Source (T : Interface.{u}) where
+  observe : {i : T.Ty} → T.State i → T.Observation i
+  legal : {i j : T.Ty} → (a : T.Action i j) → T.State i → Prop
+  kernel : {i j : T.Ty} → (a : T.Action i j) → (z : T.State i) →
+    legal a z → PMF (Output T a)
+  refusal : {i j : T.Ty} → (a : T.Action i j) → (z : T.State i) →
+    ¬ legal a z → T.Event a × T.Terminal a × T.Record a
+
+open Classical in
+def Source.total {T : Interface.{u}} (S : Source T) {i j : T.Ty}
+    (a : T.Action i j) (z : T.State i) : PMF (Output T a) :=
+  if h : S.legal a z then S.kernel a z h else
+    PMF.pure ((S.refusal a z h).1, Sum.inr (S.refusal a z h).2.1, (S.refusal a z h).2.2)
+
+/-- Only successful successors are quotiented; every event, record and terminal
+is retained exactly. The realized image changes no output equality. -/
+def jointView {T : Interface.{u}} (R : (i : T.Ty) → Setoid (T.State i))
+    {i j : T.Ty} (a : T.Action i j) (x : Output T a) :
+    T.Event a × (Quotient (R j) ⊕ T.Terminal a) × T.Record a :=
+  (x.1, Sum.map (Quotient.mk (R j)) id x.2.1, x.2.2)
+
+/-- The actual closed joint recursion starts at the current observation kernel
+and retains the preceding relation at every refinement. -/
+def residual {T : Interface.{u}} (S : Source T) :
+    ℕ → (i : T.Ty) → Setoid (T.State i)
+  | 0, _ => Setoid.ker S.observe
+  | n + 1, i => residual S n i ⊓ Setoid.ker (fun z =>
+      fun a : (j : T.Ty) × T.Action i j =>
+        (S.legal a.2 z,
+          (S.total a.2 z).map (Set.rangeFactorization (jointView (residual S n) a.2))))
+
+/-- The ordered acquired alphabet contains observations, selected parameterized
+actions, joint events and records, and distinct stop, horizon and terminal tags. -/
+inductive Token (T : Interface.{u}) where
+  | observed (i : T.Ty) (o : T.Observation i)
+  | chosen {i j : T.Ty} (a : T.Action i j)
+  | event {i j : T.Ty} (a : T.Action i j) (e : T.Event a)
+  | recorded {i j : T.Ty} (a : T.Action i j) (r : T.Record a)
+  | terminal {i j : T.Ty} (a : T.Action i j) (f : T.Terminal a)
+  | stopped (i : T.Ty)
+  | horizon (i : T.Ty)
+
+/-- Selectors and archive updates receive only declared acquired data. Permission
+checks may use the full acquired prefix and archive; source legality is separate.
+Randomized stopping is the `none` decision. -/
+structure Policy (T : Interface.{u}) (Archive : Type u) where
+  write : Archive → List (Token T) → List (Token T) → Archive
+  permitted : (i : T.Ty) → T.Observation i → Archive → List (Token T) →
+    ((j : T.Ty) × T.Action i j) → Prop
+  select : ℕ → (i : T.Ty) → T.Observation i → Archive → List (Token T) →
+    PMF (Option ((j : T.Ty) × T.Action i j))
+  selects_permitted : ∀ n i o c h a, some a ∈ (select n i o c h).support →
+    permitted i o c h a
+
+abbrev Transcript (T : Interface.{u}) (Archive : Type u) :=
+  List (Token T) × List Archive
+
+/-- Consume one complete source output, writing its event and record before
+continuing, or retaining the source's fixed terminal without continuation. -/
+def respond {T : Interface.{u}} {Archive : Type u} (P : Policy T Archive)
+    {i j : T.Ty} (next : T.State j → Archive → List (Token T) → PMF (Transcript T Archive))
+    (a : T.Action i j) (c : Archive) (h : List (Token T))
+    (x : Output T a) : PMF (Transcript T Archive) :=
+  let block := [Token.event a x.1, Token.recorded a x.2.2]
+  let c' := P.write c h block
+  let h' := h ++ block
+  match x.2.1 with
+  | .inl z => (next z c' h').map fun out => (out.1, c :: out.2)
+  | .inr f => PMF.pure (h' ++ [Token.terminal a f],
+      [c, c', P.write c' h' [Token.terminal a f]])
+
+/-- Executed laws are constructed from source rows, never supplied as a law table.
+The result retains the entire ordered acquired history jointly with the initial
+archive and each chronological archive update. -/
+def run {T : Interface.{u}} (S : Source T) {Archive : Type u} (P : Policy T Archive) :
+    ℕ → (i : T.Ty) → T.State i → Archive → List (Token T) → PMF (Transcript T Archive)
+  | 0, i, z, c, h =>
+      let obs := [Token.observed i (S.observe z)]
+      let c' := P.write c h obs
+      PMF.pure (h ++ obs ++ [Token.horizon i], [c, c', P.write c' (h ++ obs) [Token.horizon i]])
+  | n + 1, i, z, c, h =>
+      let o := S.observe z
+      let h' := h ++ [Token.observed i o]
+      let c' := P.write c h [Token.observed i o]
+      (P.select n i o c' h').bind fun decision =>
+        match decision with
+        | none => PMF.pure (h' ++ [Token.stopped i], [c, c', P.write c' h' [Token.stopped i]])
+        | some ⟨j, a⟩ =>
+            ((S.total a z).bind (respond P (run S P n j) a
+              (P.write c' h' [Token.chosen a]) (h' ++ [Token.chosen a]))).map
+                fun out => (out.1, [c, c'] ++ out.2)
+
+private theorem residual_observe {T : Interface.{u}} (S : Source T) (n : ℕ)
+    {i : T.Ty} {z w : T.State i} (h : residual S n i z w) :
+    S.observe z = S.observe w := by
+  induction n with
+  | zero => exact h
+  | succ n ih => exact ih h.1
+
+/-- At every smaller finite depth, the recursively generated joint residual
+preserves the complete ordered law of every acquired-history-only policy on
+matching archives. No continuation-law invariance is assumed. -/
+theorem recursive_residual_preserves_adaptive_law {T : Interface.{u}} (S : Source T)
+    (Archive : Type u) (n : ℕ) {i : T.Ty} {z w : T.State i}
+    (related : residual S n i z w) :
+    ∀ d ≤ n, ∀ (P : Policy T Archive) (c : Archive) (h : List (Token T)),
+      run S P d i z c h = run S P d i w c h := by
+  induction n generalizing i with
+  | zero =>
+      intro d hd P c h
+      have hd' : d = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hd
+      subst d
+      simp only [run, residual_observe S 0 related]
+  | succ n ih =>
+      intro d hd P c h
+      have ho := residual_observe S (n + 1) related
+      cases d with
+      | zero => simp only [run, ho]
+      | succ d =>
+          have hd' : d ≤ n := Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hd
+          simp only [run, ho]
+          congr 1
+          funext decision
+          cases decision with
+          | none => rfl
+          | some a =>
+              obtain ⟨j, a⟩ := a
+              let c' := P.write (P.write c h [Token.observed i (S.observe w)])
+                (h ++ [Token.observed i (S.observe w)]) [Token.chosen a]
+              let h' := (h ++ [Token.observed i (S.observe w)]) ++ [Token.chosen a]
+              let f := respond P (run S P d j) a c' h'
+              let q := jointView (residual S n) a
+              apply congrArg (PMF.map _)
+              change (S.total a z).bind f = (S.total a w).bind f
+              have hfiber : Setoid.ker q ≤ Setoid.ker f := by
+                intro x y hxy
+                rcases x with ⟨e, x, r⟩
+                rcases y with ⟨e', y, r'⟩
+                change (e, Sum.map (Quotient.mk (residual S n j)) id x, r) =
+                  (e', Sum.map (Quotient.mk (residual S n j)) id y, r') at hxy
+                obtain ⟨he, hpair⟩ := Prod.mk.inj hxy
+                obtain ⟨hnext, hr⟩ := Prod.mk.inj hpair
+                subst e'
+                subst r'
+                cases x with
+                | inl x =>
+                    cases y with
+                    | inl y =>
+                        exact congrArg (PMF.map _) (ih (Quotient.exact (Sum.inl.inj hnext)) d hd' P _ _)
+                    | inr y => cases hnext
+                | inr x =>
+                    cases y with
+                    | inl y => cases hnext
+                    | inr y =>
+                        have ht : x = y := Sum.inr.inj hnext
+                        subst y
+                        rfl
+              obtain ⟨factor, factor_eq, _⟩ :=
+                (realized_image_unique_factorization_iff_reverse_kernel f q).mpr hfiber
+              let g : Set.range q → PMF (Transcript T Archive) := fun v => (factor v).val
+              have hf : f = g ∘ Set.rangeFactorization q := by
+                funext x
+                exact congrArg Subtype.val (congrFun factor_eq x)
+              have rows := congrFun related.2 ⟨j, a⟩
+              have rows' : (S.total a z).map (Set.rangeFactorization q) =
+                  (S.total a w).map (Set.rangeFactorization q) := congrArg Prod.snd rows
+              rw [hf, ← PMF.bind_map, ← PMF.bind_map, rows']
+
+#print axioms recursive_residual_preserves_adaptive_law
+
+end D5.S3.Observer.ProbabilisticClosure.RecursiveJointTranscript

+**Lemma 50.1 (Rank and kernel at every positive width).** For every
+$b>0$, $L_{\rm w}(b)$ has rank three, and
+
+$$
+\ker L_{\rm w}(b)=\mathbb R K_{\rm w}(b),\qquad
+K_{\rm w}(b)=
+\begin{pmatrix}
+-5UH_0(b)\\3UH_1(b)\\-3TUH_2(b)\\3H_3(b)
+\end{pmatrix}.
+\tag{50.1}
+$$
+
+**Proof.** The determinant of the three columns numbered one, two and
+four of (49.2) is
+
+$$
+-\frac{3H_2(b)}{10T}\ne0,
+\tag{50.2}
+$$
+
+since $H_2(b)=11209b+37242>0$. More explicitly, delete column $i$
+and multiply its maximal minor by $(-1)^{i+1}$. In column order the
+four signed minors are
+
+$$
+\left(
+-\frac{H_0}{2T^2},\quad
+\frac{3H_1}{10T^2},\quad
+-\frac{3H_2}{10T},\quad
+\frac{3H_3}{10T^2U}
+\right).
+\tag{50.3}
+$$
+
+These equalities follow by substituting (49.1) into (49.2) and
+expanding the three-by-three determinants. Each row annihilates this
+cofactor vector, by expansion of the determinant with that row
+repeated. Multiplication of (50.3) by the positive scalar $10T^2U$
+gives $K_{\rm w}$. The nonzero minor proves rank three, so this
+nonzero kernel vector spans the entire kernel. No width at which
+$H_0$, $H_1$ or $H_3$ vanishes is deleted. $\square$
+

+drift and gain have a strict parent limit. Its gain is nonzero by the
+unequal first two readings. The remaining limits with such $b_0$
+have $r\to0$ or $1$. A zero limiting $\Lambda$ would force
+$b_0=1/8$ by $F_{\rm par}=0$, but the cubics in (20.1) are nonzero there.
+Solving for $\epsilon$ and substituting in (19.3) gives exactly
+$R_0(b_0),R_1(b_0)$.

+If $b\to\infty$, then $d\to0$. Use the scaled polynomial
+$g_{\rm sc}=Ug$. Its samples at nodes $1,2,3,4$ converge to
+$(48,294/5,48,18)$, since $j/U,n/U,T/U\to1/2$.
+Fixed-node interpolation gives $g_{\rm sc}(5)\to-144/5$,
+$g_{\rm sc}(6)\to-90$. Since $V/U\to3/2$ and $(2U+n)/U\to5/2$,
+the limiting response is $q_\infty$. This argument scales the whole
+gain and does not assume its unscaled coefficients vanish at a rate.

+(19.2) give $g(5)\to-24/5$. Since $V\to\infty$, bounded $P_5$

+or $\mathcal B_1(z)$.

+## 7. 差分、复用和开放边界
+
+本卷复用有限多数判决、$L^1$ 三角不等式、Boolean 格 Möbius 反演和上一卷的固定表示风险公式。相对于已有任务分割、失败超图、更新修复宽度、调度兼容性和固定 $q$ 的逃逸谱，它新增的是 **特征集合格上的签名取消边际与交互项**。它不重建 Galois 任务商、集合覆盖最小数，也不把一般信息次模性搬到零一证书风险。
+
+仓内机器学习白盒卷的 §34 已在具体有限 FIB 排列纤维和均匀律下给出 $\min\{p_f,1-p_f\}$ 型的零一 Bayes 纤维风险。本卷把同一决策事实推广到任意有限状态质量、任意确定性特征格和任意二元证书坐标，并新增签名 $L^1$ 正规形、精确取消边际与交互分解；不把该具体先例冒称为本卷首次发现。
+
+仍然开放的边界如下：
+
+1. 没有给出实际 FIB R2 的完整状态、特征表、失败边和部署分布；
+2. 没有把 $\mu$-加权风险外推为全状态结构保证；
+3. 没有声称一般次模、超模、贪心近似或特征选择算法；
+4. 连续参数、随机训练、自适应特征采购和采购成本需要新的策略类与损失合同；
+5. 条件独立下的互信息次模性属于另一种风险/效用对象，不能替代本卷的集合值零一风险；
+6. 高阶 Möbius 系数是有限集合函数的交互坐标，不自动是物理或因果原子。
+
+对真正 FIB 实例化，必须补齐有限状态集、特征映射 $\xi_i$、失败坐标标签、分布 $\mu$、权重 $\omega$ 和至少一个联合特征的纤维分离见证。数据齐全后，$\rho_\tau$ 和 $\Gamma_{ij\mid A,d}$ 才能成为实际诊断，而不是说明性合同。

+## 6. 机器学习白盒性的高阶边界
+
+在一个固定输入、固定检查点、固定随机种子和固定有限干预 horizon 下，把多任务模型、多个参数子系统或多个干预通道抽象为 $m$ 个有限根协议。每个局部词是该通道允许的更新序列，$W$ 是声明的训练合同允许的联合更新词元组。对固定根对，局部解释提供 $S_i$ 或 $C_i$ 见证；这只是有限确定性接口的抽象。
+
+定理 2.1 给出多头白盒证书的精确结构：一个联合逃逸必须包含一个真实可实现的全局更新词元组、一个目标差异坐标和其余所有坐标的共同支持。定理 3.2 则给出一个具体失败模式：构造出的两个调度关系具有相同的所有两两调度投影，三头或更高头的联合调度却不同。
+
+因此，白盒性有两个必须分开的层次：
+
+- **局部可解释性：** 每个任务头都能给出自己的冲突或支持记录；
+- **联合可认证性：** 这些记录属于同一个全局调度、同一个根对和同一个终端读数合同。
+
+若调度合同可证明是 $2$ 可分解，且两两表是精确投影并带有同根、同记录的 `Lift` 证书，二阶兼容表足以支持联合认证；若 $\alpha(W)>2$，只保留两两调度表就可能产生错误的联合候选，但这不表示每个具体模型都必然失败。连接树定理说明，在每个 $R_B$ 都是同一合法全局调度关系的精确作用域投影、分隔投影相等、运行交集条件成立，并且根一致提升可沿拼接保留的附加假设下，存在逐树扩展的联合证书构造；这是一条结构性构造结论，不单独给出复杂度界。环形作用域中，分隔一致性本身不足够；必须加入闭环联合关系并验证重叠一致性，或使用满足运行交集的树分解及其袋关系。
+
+这给出一个有限确定性模型内的白盒质量判据：报告不能只列“每个头单独解释成功”，还必须给出兼容阶、全局词元组或一个可验证的连接树拼接证书。$\alpha(W)$ 是联合白盒接口的结构复杂度指标；它不是神经网络参数量、泛化误差或概率鲁棒性的替代量。
+
+对 FIB 原子尤其要保留三类信息：
+
+1. **坐标域：** 使用声明的原子和合法模式类型，不能把一个共享模式拆成两个互不相容的端点原子；
+2. **发生次序：** 重复请求、停止守卫和继续方向需要带 occurrence 与位置索引，集合化的超图会丢失顺序；
+3. **共同来源：** 不同检查点、不同随机种子或不同数据变换得到的局部关系，不能仅因边缘表相同就当作同一模型上的联合关系。

+## 0. 本卷新增的内容
+
+已有[证书保持商卷](FIB_ATOM_CERTIFICATE_PRESERVING_QUOTIENT.md)证明：如果摘要逐状态重建完整失败边并与更新交换，那么当前和未来的横截结构可以在商上恢复。本卷再向递归方向推进一步，但只承担一个更窄的问题：
+
+$$
+\text{递归子层的失败边}
+\longrightarrow
+\text{不交的逃逸打包}
+\longrightarrow
+\text{匹配数和横截数的递推下界}.
+$$
+
+这里有一个必须保留的逻辑分界。
+
+1. 子层的注入必须是**诱导超图嵌入**；只有边反射而没有边保持时，连单调性都不能推出。
+2. 两个子层各自的局部匹配只能给出加法项 $\nu^{(0)}+\nu^{(1)}$。一条普通交叉边不能自动再给一个单位。
+3. 匹配递推和横截递推是不同命题。一般超图中 $\nu\le\tau$ 可以严格成立，不能把二者互换。
+4. 状态更新的交换式只传输状态；失败边还必须满足更新下的等变性，并且交叉边族要对更新封闭。
+
+本卷的 $\nu$、$\tau$ 也不重命名已有冲突图色数 $\chi$。色数回答“固定标签如何分离两两冲突的根”，而这里的匹配数和横截数回答“修复超图中能同时打包多少条失败边、至少要选多少个观察点”。只有在额外声明把失败边转成二元冲突并证明相应对应时，二者才可能通过一个新映射联系；本卷不作这种自动识别。
+
+因此，本卷得到的是“若具体 FIB 层满足哪些可检验合同，则可以推出什么”，而不是把这些合同当作实际编码的事实。

+**Lemma 48.1 (The zero-safe parent and its actual-world lift).** The full
+five-row parent consists exactly of $b>0$, $0<r<1$, $\epsilon\in\mathbb R$
+satisfying
+
+$$
+\epsilon\Lambda+D_{\rm par}=0.
+\tag{48.2}
+$$
+
+Its corresponding complete world has $P=P(r,b)$, $d=24+\epsilon$, and
+
+$$
+\begin{gathered}
+z_0=-24-\epsilon,\quad z_1=-\epsilon/j,\quad
+z_2=(27/5-\epsilon)/T,\quad z_3=-\epsilon/n,\\
+g(s)=\sum_{i=0}^3 z_i\ell_i(s),\qquad
+\ell_i(s)=\prod_{\substack{0\le k\le3\\ k\ne i}}\frac{s-k}{i-k}.
+\end{gathered}
+\tag{48.3}
+$$
+
+This is a bijection with complete worlds, including every source with
+$\Lambda=0$.
+
+**Proof.** All of $j,n,T,U$ are strictly positive on the source domain.
+The literal traces, already obtained in Lemma 2.2, are
+
+$$
+\begin{array}{c|rrrrrrrrr}
+\text{clock/action}&0&1,J&2,M&3,J&4,M&5,M&6,M&7,J&7,M\\ \hline
+\text{trace}&1&j&T&n&U&U+n&2U+n&T+2j+4r&3U+2n.
+\end{array}
+\tag{48.4}
+$$
+
+The first four original readings therefore force exactly the four
+samples in (48.3). A polynomial of degree at most three is uniquely
+determined by these samples. The fixed-node weights give
+
+$$
+\begin{array}{c|rrrr}
+s&\ell_0(s)&\ell_1(s)&\ell_2(s)&\ell_3(s)\\ \hline
+4&-1&4&-6&4\\
+5&-4&15&-20&10\\
+6&-10&36&-45&20\\
+7&-20&70&-84&35.
+\end{array}
+\tag{48.5}
+$$
+
+Substitution of the first row into the fifth original reading gives
+
+$$
+d+Ug(4)-18=U(\epsilon\Lambda+D_{\rm par}).
+\tag{48.6}
+$$

+After division of this residual by $U$, its constant term is
+$6/U+24-162/(5T)=D_{\rm par}$, and its coefficient of $\epsilon$
+is $\Lambda$. Hence (48.2) is both necessary and sufficient. The source
+matrix is legal because $b>0$, $0<r<1$, and (48.3) has degree at most
+three. Its whole gain cannot vanish identically: otherwise the first
+two readings would both be $d$, contrary to $0\ne24$. Conversely every
+parent world fixes $(b,r,\epsilon)$ and these samples, proving the
+bijection. This is the target-parent correspondence of Section 19 and
+*FIB common-parent geometry and two exact mixed children*, Theorem 2.1,
+with its reconstruction displayed in the present notation. $\square$

+interpolation-node differences, never by $\Lambda$, a gain sample,

+### 推论 5.3（递归五路分流的高阶守卫）
+
+对固定产品根对 $q=(\mathbf x,\mathbf x')$，令
+
+$$

+$$
+
+并令 $L_q$ 为所采用低阶投影阴影生成的候选词元组集合。按“先判全局支持、再逐词分类”的顺序，五路守卫为：
+
+1. $U_q=\varnothing$：该根对没有可实现的共同支持，属于结构性空支持；
+2. $L_q\setminus W\ne\varnothing$：低阶阴影含有被高阶联合约束拒绝的候选，不能建立逃逸边；
+3. 对某个具体 $\mathbf w\in W\setminus U_q$，至少一个支持记录不存在：该词元组的联合运行不可达；
+4. 对某个 $\mathbf w\in U_q$，没有冲突坐标：当前根对在该调度下安全，继续检查后继响应；

+
+已有 FIB 五类接口为：语法原子、行为原子、关系原子、证书原子、更新原子。递归逃逸打包只直接作用于后三者的交接：

+|---|---|---|
+| 语法原子 | 递归候选顶点和局部合法性可作为 $V_n$ 的来源 | 五窗字典、接缝和实际 FIB 生成规则的对应 |
+| 行为原子 | 状态注入 $J_b$ 与更新交换 | 后继响应确实由所声明的状态决定 |
+| 关系原子 | 失败边族 $\mathscr E_n$ 的递归限制 | 联合关系是否等于这些失败边 |
+| 证书原子 | $\nu_n,\tau_n$ 和 cross witness 的打包下界 | 完整失败边能否从具体摘要逐状态重建 |
+| 更新原子 | (4.1)--(4.3) 的路径交换 | 训练、恢复或外部回写是否真的满足该合同 |
+
+因此，机器学习中的白盒性可以写成一个条件命题：若模型表示 $q_n$ 同时因子化行为响应、完整失败边和更新/cross 闭包，则它至少需要区分由上述递归超图产生的公共细化类；若存在一个纤维内逃逸见证，则该表示不能同时完成对应的证书任务。
+
+这并不等于“模型参数越多越白盒”，也不等于五类接口各需要一个神经元。它给出的是可检验的失败模式：

+Let
+$$

+ I_p=(p_{\rm f}-\eta,p_{\rm f}+\eta),\qquad I_r=(\alpha_{\rm f}-R,\alpha_{\rm f}+R).

+$\beta_{\rm f}(q,r)\in(1-10^{-6},1+10^{-6})$ satisfying
+$$
+ p(r,\beta_{\rm f}(q,r))=q.
+ \tag{34.2}
+$$
+The function $\beta_{\rm f}$ is real analytic. Its two-variable notation
+distinguishes it from the fixed parent parameter $\beta=1/8$.

+**Proof.** At $b=1$, integration of $7<p_r<8$ gives
+$|p(r,1)-p_{\rm f}|<8R=4\cdot10^{-6}$. Integrating $p_b>96$ from
+$b=1$ to either horizontal box edge shows that the corresponding
+endpoint responses lie below $p_{\rm f}-92\cdot10^{-6}$ and above
+$p_{\rm f}+92\cdot10^{-6}$. They bracket all of $I_p$.
+Strict increase in $b$, the intermediate value theorem and the
+analytic implicit function theorem give existence, uniqueness and
+analyticity. The relevant segments stay in $\mathcal B_{\rm f}$; (32.4) and (33.1)
+put the whole closed $r$-strip inside its vertical extent. ∎
+
+Write
+$$
+ h(q,r)=v(r,\beta_{\rm f}(q,r)),\quad
+ a_q(r)=a(r,\beta_{\rm f}(q,r)),\quad m_q(r)=m(r,\beta_{\rm f}(q,r)).
+$$
+Implicit differentiation of (34.2) gives
+$$
+ \beta_{\rm f}_r=-p_r/p_b=t,\qquad \beta_{\rm f}_q=1/p_b,
+ \qquad h_r=v_r-v_b p_r/p_b=-\det DA/p_b.
+$$
+A second differentiation at fixed $q$, using
+$\beta_{\rm f}_{rr}=-T_p/p_b$, gives
+$$

+ \tag{34.3}

+ 556<a_q'<561,\quad133<m_q'<141

+
+在纤维 $u$ 的正质量
+

+ m_{d,A}(u)=M^+_{d,A}(u)+M^-_{d,A}(u)>0

+则
+
+$$
+ e_d(A)=
+ \sum_{u}m_{d,A}(u)\min\{\eta_{d,A}(u),1-\eta_{d,A}(u)\}
+ =\frac12\sum_um_{d,A}(u)\left(1-|2\eta_{d,A}(u)-1|\right).
+$$
+
+更准确地，后验置信边距的质量为
+
+$$

+=\|\sigma_{d,A}\|_1,
+$$
+
